(2024) 概念性预期;重要的负面结果，对社区有实际价值（节省无效投入），但主要贡献是诊断性的，constructive contribution 仅限弱生成器上的 cross-architecture escape\", \"rootId\": \"\"}, {\"messageId\": \"om_x100b6e144c8584a0c4ea22c37066c01\", \"senderId\": \"cli_a97eeddd32b9dcba\", \"createTime\": \"1779564580634\", \"msgType\": \"post\", \"content\": \"🔄 [ 重新审稿] 📋  [审稿群 → Research Director] 审稿报告 Round 17 \\n Overall:  3.5 - Borderline Conference 审稿报告：Beyond Self-Consistency: Self-Extracted Constraints Provide No Detectable Improvement in LLM Reasoning 目标 venue : EMNLP 2026 (ARR May cycle, deadline 2026-05-25)\\n 审稿轮次 : Round 20（fresh 重新审稿）\\n Reviewer 编排 : R1（方法严谨性+实验有效性）、R2（新颖性+完整性+写作质量）\\n 交叉分享 : 完成，两位 Reviewer 均提交逐条 [ AGREE]/[ REBUT ] 回应\\n 格式检查 : 正文 8 页 ✓ | ACL review 模板 ✓ | Anonymous ✓ | Abstract ~ 196 词 ✓ | Limitations 在正文 ✓ Summary 本文提出 SICA（Symbolic Invariant Consensus Aggregation），从 LLM chain-of-thought 轨迹中自提取逻辑约束，经 Z3 weighted partial MAX-SAT 聚合答案。核心发现为负面结果：在 6 个模型（7B-32B）、多个推理领域上，SICA 与 Self-Consistency 在 >90% 问题上答案一致，经 BH FDR 校正后无统计显著正向效应。作者将此诊断为 \\\"symbolic confirmation bias\\\"（SCB）——自提取约束系统性追随多数答案（bias ratio 1.66-4.97×，9 models from 7B to frontier）。Observation 1（Argmax Preservation）和 Remark 1（DPI Information Ceiling）提供结构性解释。27 种 training-free 变体均因 independence-accuracy trade-off 失败。Cross-architecture verification（DeBERTa NLI）仅在弱生成器上显著（+6.67 pp, p<0.001）。三个零成本诊断指标（C₀, K_ eff, BR）预判失败模式。 Strengths S1. 统计方法论严谨性远超同类负面结果论文 [R1, R2 共识] \\n McNemar exact test + 10,000 bootstrap CI + BH FDR correction (m=6 confirmatory) + TOST equivalence (±2pp) + power analysis (MDE) + multi-seed replication (3-5 seeds)。区分了 \\\"no effect detected\\\" 和 \\\"equivalence confirmed\\\"，在 NLP 负面结果论文中极为罕见。（§3.2, §4, Table 1, Appendix D-E） S2. 失败机制诊断逻辑自洽 [R1, R2 共识] \\n SCB 诊断链条完整：BR > 1 → degeneration (|C\\\\|/|C| ≈ 0.034) → argmax preservation → 803/804 agreement (Table 10)。DAG 因果图（Figure 3）直观展示信息瓶颈。Constraint ablation（MAX-SAT vs count-only vs random-weight）令人信服地证明约束未携带超越投票计数的信号。 S3. 结构性解释超越纯经验观察 [R2 主要, R1 同意] \\n Observation 1 + Remark 1 将\\\"self-extraction doesn't work\\\"从经验发现提升为结构性解释——在 self-extraction 范式内，约束无法携带超越 trace 本身的信息。这是对 Huang et al. (2024) 的实质推进：解释了 为什么 即使在 provably sound solver (Z3) 下仍然失败。 S4. 27 种 remediation 策略的系统性失败 [R1, R2 共识] \\n Figure 4 + Table 14 覆盖 prompt-level (9)、method-level (3)、analytical conditions (17)，跨 diverse prompting、iterative refinement、contrastive scoring、atom pipeline、UNSAT filtering 等方向。有力地证明退化是结构性的而非调参问题。 S5. 诊断框架可操作性强 [R1, R2 共识] \\n C₀（multi-candidate rate）、K_ eff（effective ensemble size）、BR（bias ratio）三指标零成本可计算（无需 ground truth），Type A/B/C 分类正确预测所有 60 个测试条件的失败模式。为从业者提供 K=12 pilot run 即可判断的 \\\"try before deploy\\\" 工具。（§5.3, Table 5） S6. Cross-architecture escape 提供建设性方向 [R1, R2 共识] \\n DeBERTa NLI 在 Mistral-7B 上 +6.67 pp (p <0.001)，且 cross-model voting vs cross-architecture NLI 对比（Table cross-model-ablation）区分了 ensemble diversity 和 structural independence。CCR 指标（Appendix C）和 108 种 verifier-generator 组合提供量化框架。 S7. 写作质量整体良好 [R2 主要, R1 同意] \\n 叙事从 \\\"symbolic verification should help\\\" → \\\"it doesn't\\\" → \\\"here's why structurally\\\" → \\\"here's how to diagnose/escape\\\" 连贯。Abstract ~ 196 词符合 EMNLP 限制。Related Work 5 段分类合理（SC/ensemble + neuro-symbolic + CoT bias distinction + test-time compute + training-based）。Limitations 简洁覆盖主要局限。 Weaknesses Must-Fix（1 项，Director 综合判定） W1. Oracle 实验仅限形式逻辑领域，核心因果主张的外部效度不足 [R1-N1 Must-Fix, R2 AGREE] -  Oracle control（用 gold DSL/FOL 标注替换自提取约束）仅在 FOLIO 和 ProofWriter 上进行，均为形式逻辑领域。核心因果推断——\\\"瓶颈在自提取质量而非聚合机制本身\\\"——的直接证据领域受限。 -  替代假说未排除：MAX-SAT 对数学推理或常识推理的约束类型可能天然不适用。 -  ProofWriter oracle 的 97.14% accuracy 证明了聚合机制在给定好约束时有效，但仅限形式逻辑。 -  Section 1 贡献声明暗示跨域通用性，但 oracle 证据不支撑。 -  建议 ：(a) Limitations 中明确 oracle 因果推断的域局限性；(b) 论证逻辑推理是 SCB 的 \\\"best-case\\\" domain（constraint formalization 最自然），因此 negative result 具有下界意义；(c) 或在 GSM8K 上构建 partial oracle。 Should-Fix（6 项） W2. Observation 1 的形式化程度与 Abstract/Intro 呈现不匹配 [R1-N2 Must-Fix→Director 降为 Should-Fix, R2 AGREE] -  三个退化条件均使用 \\\"≈\\\" 且无误差界。Abstract 称 \\\"The failure is structural (Observation 1)\\\"——\\\"structural\\\" 暗示形式化证明但实际是半形式化经验观察。 -  R2 指出论文恰当使用 \\\"Observation\\\" 而非 \\\"Theorem\\\"，条件(i) |C\\\\|/|C| ≤ 0.034 有量化。Director 同意 R2 评估，将此降为 Should-Fix。 -  建议 ：Abstract/Intro 使用 \\\"empirically structural\\\" 或 \\\"systematic\\\" 替代 \\\"structural\\\"。 W3. 新颖性相对于 Huang et al. (2024) 的差异化论述需更锐利 [R2-N2 Must-Fix→Director 降为 Should-Fix, R1 REBUT] -  论文多次使用 \\\"extends and formalizes\\\" Huang et al.，给人 \\\"confirmatory study\\\" 印象。 -  R1 反驳：论文实际贡献远超 confirmation——完整 formal pipeline (Z3 MAX-SAT) + 27 strategies + escape + diagnostics，Huang et al. 完全没有。问题在 framing 太谦虚而非贡献不足。 -  Director 判断：同意 R1。论文实质贡献独立且充分。建议 frame 为 \\\"reveals a deeper structural mechanism that Huang's empirical observation did not explain\\\"，而非 \\\"extends and formalizes\\\"。 W4. 标题 \\\"No Detectable Improvement\\\" 的 scope 与 cross-architecture 正面结果存在张力 [R2-N1 Must-Fix→Director 降为 Should-Fix, R1 REBUT] -  R2 担忧读者可能理解为 \\\"symbolic constraints don't help LLM reasoning\\\"。 -  R1 反驳：标题限定词 \\\"Self-Extracted Constraints\\\" 已充分区分——cross-architecture escape 的增益来源是外部验证器的独立信号，不是自提取约束。 -  Director 判断：同意 R1，标题在技术上精确。但建议在 Abstract 中更早区分 self-extracted vs cross-architecture，减少误读风险。 W5. Capability-gap pattern 证据基础薄弱 [R1-W2 + R2-W4 共识] -  核心单调性主张依赖 n=6 generator-verifier 配对（Spearman ρ=1.0, p=0.003）。 -  108 种 verifier-generator-weight 组合（Figure 8）扩展覆盖面，但核心趋势仍受限。 -  仅弱生成器（SC ≤ 72%）上显著，强生成器 Δ ≤ +0.83 pp 甚至负向。实用价值局限。 -  建议 ：增加更多能力梯度生成器，或明确标注为 \\\"preliminary evidence\\\"。 W6. Remark 1 (DPI bound) 理论贡献有限 [R1-W1 + R2-W1 共识] -  DPI（I(f(X);Y) ≤ I(X;Y)）是确定性后处理的教科书性质，非 SICA 特有。 -  \\\"Information Ceiling\\\" 命名暗示特定理论发现，但实际贡献是识别 M→T→A→C Markov chain 结构。 -  建议 ：降低展示权重，将重点放在 \\\"identifying the Markov structure\\\" 上。 W7. α 系统消融缺失 [R1-Q2 + R2-Q2 共识] -  Table 11 显示 MAX-SAT vs count-only agreement ≥99% across α ∈ [ 0.1, 0.9]，但这是 count-only 替换而非移除 answer_ assertion。 -  α→0 时（完全依赖 Z3 可满足性权重，不用 source-attribution）退化是否减弱？这直接关系到 Observation 1 条件(ii) source-attribution 的必要性。 -  建议 ：在 Appendix 中报告 α 的完整消融，特别是 α=0 条件。 Minor（6 项） -  M1. \\\"pp\\\"（percentage points）未在首次使用时定义 [ R2-M1 ] -  M2. Figure 2 散点图灰度打印可读性可改善（marker shape 差异不足）[ R1-M1, R2-M2 ] -  M3. Figure 4 策略名称文字较密集，部分长文本打印时约 6-7pt [ 视觉审查 warning ] -  M4. Figure 4 四个 category 灰度打印时颜色区分不足 [ 视觉审查 warning ] -  M5. Table 1 脚注符号密度较高（* ,†,◦,●），可考虑简化 [ R1-M2 ] -  M6. 匿名 repo 建议——对负面结果论文的复现尤其重要 [ R2-M5 ] Reviewer Consensus [ AGREE ] 以下关键问题两位 Reviewer 达成共识： 1.  Oracle 领域覆盖不足 是核心缺陷（R1-N1 ≈ R2-W2 底层关切） 2. 1	Can symbolic verification via a provably sound solver improve Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning when constraints are self-extracted from the model's own traces? We find no detectable improvement exceeding ${\sim}$2 percentage points (pp) under self-extraction. We introduce Symbolic Invariant Consensus Aggregation (SICA), which extracts logical constraints from chain-of-thought traces via weighted MAX-SAT. Despite Z3 validating 99\% of self-extracted constraints, SICA matches majority voting on over 90\% of problems across six models (7B--32B) and three domains. No condition shows a significant positive effect after FDR control; four of six powered conditions confirm equivalence within $\pm$2\,pp (TOST); the remainder are underpowered for smaller effects. The failure is systematic: self-extracted constraints track the majority answer---a property we term \emph{symbolic confirmation bias} (bias ratios $1.66$--$4.97\times$ across nine models, 7B to frontier). Under source-attribution scoring and degeneration, SICA reduces to majority vote (Observation~1); the $M{\to}T{\to}A{\to}C$ Markov chain bounds self-extracted information (Remark~1), revealing a deeper structural mechanism underlying \citet{huang2024selfcorrect}'s findings. Twenty-seven training-free variants fail due to a persistent independence-accuracy trade-off. Breaking the self-extraction dependency, cross-architecture verification escapes the bias ($+6.67$\,pp on the weakest generator, $p < 0.001$). Three zero-cost diagnostics characterize failure modes across all tested conditions.

1	\section{Discussion and Conclusion}
2	\label{sec:discussion}
3	\label{sec:conclusion}
4	
5	\looseness=-1
6	Our central finding is that the value of formal verification depends on the \emph{independence} of its inputs, not the soundness of its logic. \emph{SICA-specific}: under source-attribution scoring, SICA reduces to majority vote (Observation~1), and 27 training-free variants fail to escape. \emph{General}: the DPI bound (Remark~1) applies to any deterministic self-extraction, and symbolic confirmation bias---a structural property of self-extraction pipelines, not a cognitive bias analogy---holds across nine models (7B to frontier), suggesting the bottleneck is intrinsic to self-referential constraint generation. Three diagnostics ($K_\text{eff}$, BR, $C_0$) correctly characterize failure modes across all tested conditions, with boundaries generalizing to held-out families (\S\ref{sec:diagnostic-framework}).
7	
8	\looseness=-1
9	These results connect to ensemble diversity theory \citep{dietterich2000ensemble, krogh1994neural}: ensemble gain requires error independence, which $K_\text{eff}$ operationalizes for LLM trace aggregation. With $K_\text{eff} \leq 3.62$ for $K{=}12$, same-model traces scale redundancy, not information---revealing a deeper structural mechanism underlying \citet{huang2024selfcorrect}'s empirical findings. This has direct consequences for test-time compute scaling \citep{snell2025scaling}: increasing $K$ within a single model yields diminishing returns when traces share systematic biases, regardless of the aggregation mechanism applied.
10	
11	\looseness=-1
12	Escaping the bottleneck requires structural independence (\S\ref{sec:cross-arch}); cross-architecture NLI provides a proof of concept, but whether trained extractors or hybrid approaches can shift the boundary remains open. Our diagnostic framework offers a concrete tool: a $K{=}12$ pilot run with three zero-cost metrics predicts whether any self-extraction method will help before full deployment.

\looseness=-1 Two controls rule out answer leakage: BR is uniform across reasoning steps (Fisher $p = 0.71$), and removing answer sentences before extraction yields no BR decrease (Wilcoxon $p \geq 0.12$) despite accuracy loss (McNemar $p < 0.013$). The bias reflects a distributional prior embedded throughout reasoning, not answer contamination.

\label{sec:process-kappa}
\looseness=-1 Reasoning-process overlap exceeds answer-level correlation: mean process similarity (pairwise TF-IDF cosine) reaches 0.69 on Mistral-7B FOLIO, far exceeding answer-level $\kappa$ ($0.41$--$0.51$). The gap generalizes across four families (Table~\ref{tab:cross-model-process}). Under cross-model extraction, SICA gain decreases monotonically with process similarity ($\rho = -1.0$, $p = 0.008$; Table~\ref{tab:process-gradient}; conditional correction analysis in Appendix~\ref{app:cil}).

\looseness=-1 These patterns---universal BR $> 1$, structural equivalence to trace-count distributions, and process-level correlation exceeding answer-level agreement---follow from a structural property of self-extraction pipelines.

\smallskip\noindent
\textbf{Observation 1} \textit{(Argmax Preservation).}\;%
Let $t_1, \ldots, t_K \overset{\mathrm{i.i.d.}}{\sim} P_M(\cdot \mid q)$ with trace-determined answers $a_i = h(t_i)$ and $n_a = |\{i : a_i = a\}|$.
Under (i)~the degeneration condition $|\mathcal{C}^{\setminus}| \approx 0$ (Eq.~\ref{eq:degenerate}), (ii)~source-attribution scoring where $\sigma(c,a) {=} 1$ iff $c$ originates from a trace producing $a$ (Eq.~\ref{eq:score}), and (iii)~approximately uniform constraint yield per trace within each answer group, SICA reduces to majority vote: $\arg\max_a \operatorname{score}(a) = \arg\max_a n_a$.

\smallskip\noindent
\textit{Empirical support.}\;%
The degeneration condition is quantified by the Z3 rejection rate: $|\mathcal{C}^{\setminus}|/|\mathcal{C}| \approx 0.034$, confirming $|\mathcal{C}^{\setminus}| \approx 0$. Source-attribution restricts each constraint's contribution to its originating answer. For condition~(iii), per-trace constraint yield averages ${\sim}5.7$ constraints across answer groups with no systematic group-level differences (Appendix~\ref{app:constraint-quality}), making total weight approximately proportional to $n_a$. SICA and majority vote select the same answer on 96.1\% of problems for Qwen2.5-14B ($n{=}804$; Table~\ref{tab:ablation}) and over 90\% across all tested conditions.

\smallskip\noindent
\textbf{Remark 1} \textit{(Self-Extraction Bound).}\;%
If constraints are trace-determined ($c_i = f(t_i)$), the data processing inequality gives $I(C_{1:K};\, Y) \leq I(T_{1:K};\, Y)$---a standard result for any deterministic post-processing. The contribution is identifying the $M{\to}T{\to}A{\to}C$ Markov chain structure: under the degeneration condition of Observation~1 ($|\mathcal{C}^{\setminus}| \approx 0$), constraints are fully determined by answers, yielding the tighter bound $I(C;\, Y) \leq I(A;\, Y)$ and the approximate conditional independence $C \approx\!\!\perp Y \mid A$ shown in Figure~\ref{fig:causal-dag}. This is an empirical conclusion holding under degeneration, not an unconditional structural claim.

\smallskip\noindent
\textbf{Remark 2.}\;%
Observation~1 assumes degeneration and source attribution. Under \emph{semantic} evaluation, the equivalence additionally requires \emph{answer alignment}: $P(c_i \text{ supports } a_i) \geq P(c_i \text{ supports } a')$ for $a' \neq a_i$, which is structurally motivated and empirically validated ($\mathrm{BR} \in [1.66,\, 4.97]$; Table~\ref{tab:frontier-scb}), but could fail if $f$ systematically extracted premises contradicting their source trace's conclusion.
Since Observation~1 shows SICA reduces to majority vote under degeneration, $\mathrm{BR} \geq 1$ follows from the trace-count geometry; the empirical BR consistently exceeds this floor ($1.66\times$--$4.97\times$; Table~\ref{tab:frontier-scb}), reflecting both base-rate effects and extraction alignment.
